docs.title: Hardware Requirements
docs.text: Understand what you need and how existing hardware can work in your bridge.

docs.title: Console Station Requirements
docs.text:
What each station needs:

  • Touchscreen interface (tablet, monitor with touch, laptop)
  • Local audio output (speaker, headphones, built-in)
  • Network connectivity (WiFi or ethernet)
  • Ability to run bridge client software

Compatible devices:

  • Tablets: Android, iPad, Windows tablets
  • Small Computers: Raspberry Pi + monitor, mini PCs, old laptops
  • Phones: Large smartphones work for basic stations
  • All-in-ones: Tablet PCs, touchscreen laptops

docs.title: Game Server Requirements
docs.text:
What the server needs:

  • Modern CPU (anything from last 5-10 years)
  • 4GB+ RAM (8GB recommended)
  • Network connectivity
  • Ability to run bridge coordination software

Compatible systems:

  • Desktop PCs (Windows, Mac, Linux)
  • Laptops with adequate power
  • Small servers, NUC, or mini PCs
  • Even some high-end tablets can work

docs.title: Environmental Systems
docs.text:
Main Display (optional but recommended):

  • Any TV with HDMI input
  • Computer monitor (24"+ preferred)
  • Projector setup

Audio System:

  • Existing stereo or speaker system
  • Computer speakers
  • Even a good Bluetooth speaker works

Lighting Effects (optional):

  • Addressable LED strips (WS2812B)
  • Smart bulbs (Philips Hue, etc.)
  • Simple colored lights

docs.title: Network Architecture
docs.text:
Simple WiFi setup:

  • All devices connect to your home WiFi
  • Game server acts as bridge coordinator
  • Standard TCP/IP networking
  • No special networking hardware required

How data flows:

  1. Game server sends different interfaces to each station
  2. Stations send control inputs back to server
  3. Server coordinates all actions and effects
  4. Environmental systems respond to server commands

docs.title: Compatibility Notes
docs.text:
Operating Systems:

  • Stations: Android, iOS, Windows, Linux
  • Server: Windows, Mac, Linux

Performance:

  • Low requirements - most devices from last 5 years work
  • Tablets need to handle web browser or simple app
  • Server needs enough power for coordination + effects

Screen Sizes:

  • Minimum: 5" phone screen
  • Comfortable: 7-10" tablet
  • Optimal: 10"+ touchscreen
  • Premium: 27"+ touch monitors

Focus on understanding requirements, then match with hardware you have.
